title: Cold rebuild: transfers that cannot deadlock
summary: The ordered transfer again, from an empty editor, checked under every interleaving.

steps.title: From memory
body: Rebuild `Account` and `Bank.Transfer` from *Two locks, two threads, no progress*: an empty editor, no hints. Two transfers in
opposite directions run under every interleaving; a deadlock fails the check and is drawn for you.

steps.prompt: Warm-up: what makes a global lock order prevent deadlock?
options: No thread can hold a later lock while waiting for an earlier one, so a cycle of waits cannot form
Only one thread can run at a time
The runtime detects the cycle and breaks it
steps.explain: .NET does not detect or break Monitor deadlocks. Ordering makes the circular wait impossible.

steps.title: Rebuild the transfer cold
prompt: Write `class Account(int id, int balance)` with `int Id` and a public `int Balance` field, and `static class Bank` with
`static void Transfer(Account from, Account to, int amount)` that locks both accounts and can never deadlock, whatever the direction.
